boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, under-21-safe outdoor meetups at Vallejo public parks; bring your own water and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Waterfront walk at Independence Park
cards.subtitle: West Vallejo • Mare Island Way
cards.notes: Meet by the waterfront, take the walking paths together, and pause at the historic features and views of Mare Island.
cards.short_summary: A low-key waterfront walk with river and Mare Island views.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD identifies Independence Park on Mare Island Way and lists walking paths, Napa River and Mare Island views, and historic features. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.source_title: Independence Park | Greater Vallejo Recreation District
cards.access_notes: Use the public walking paths; check current park conditions before going.

cards.title: Bay Trail stroll at Glen Cove Waterfront Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • San Francisco Bay Trail connection
cards.notes: Pick a meeting point near the mature trees, walk the trail connection, and make the waterfront view the conversation break.
cards.short_summary: A scenic outdoor hang built around a Bay Trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD describes Glen Cove Waterfront Park as a natural park with trail connections to the San Francisco Bay Trail, mature trees, and views. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Stay on established trails and observe posted park guidance.

cards.title: Labyrinth lap at Grant Mahony Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • neighborhood park
cards.notes: Walk the labyrinth at an easy pace, then regroup by the open turf or ping-pong tables for a no-equipment catch-up.
cards.short_summary: A conversation-friendly park stop with a walkable labyrinth.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Grant Mahony Park’s children’s play area, open turf, picnic tables, labyrinth, and ping-pong tables. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use unreserved public areas and bring any game equipment you want to use.

cards.title: Napa River view break at Delta Meadows Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • Napa River views
cards.notes: Gather at the walkway, take a short lap, and use the river view as a relaxed outdoor reset between classes.
cards.short_summary: A brief riverside walk with an easy meetup point.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Delta Meadows Park’s walkway, half basketball courts, children’s play area, and views of the Napa River. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use the public walkway and respect any posted court-use rules.

cards.title: Walking-trail meetup at Beverly Hills Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • Del Sur Street area
cards.notes: Take a loop on the walking trail, then sit or stand by the turfed play area for a simple daylight group check-in.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood trail walk with broad Vallejo views.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Beverly Hills Park’s play equipment, walking trail, turfed play areas, and view of Vallejo. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Keep to the trail and public park areas during daylight.

cards.title: Perimeter-trail loop at Borges Ranch Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • Borges Lane
cards.notes: Set an easy lap around the perimeter walking trail, then use the individual picnic tables for a bring-your-own conversation circle.
cards.short_summary: A small-park walk that works for a casual group reset.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Borges Ranch Park’s perimeter walking trail, multi-use field, picnic tables, water fountain, and play equipment. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use unreserved areas and leave tables available for other park users.

cards.title: Court-side catch-up at Crest Ranch Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • neighborhood park
cards.notes: Meet near the basketball courts, shoot around only if the court is open, or use the picnic tables for an outdoor hang.
cards.short_summary: A flexible park meetup with courts, tables, and open space.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Crest Ranch Park’s basketball courts, softball fields, soccer field, picnic tables, play area, and restrooms. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Do not use reserved fields; share courts and follow posted rules.

cards.title: Horseshoe-pit hang at City Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • Sacramento and Louisiana area
cards.notes: Bring friends for a park-table catch-up, or use the horseshoe-pit area if it is open and you have your own equipment.
cards.short_summary: A classic neighborhood-park meetup with picnic space.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists City Park’s wooden play area, picnic tables, turfed play area, restrooms, and horseshoe pits. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: No equipment is supplied; use only public, unreserved park areas.

cards.title: Picnic-table study break at Fairmont Park
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • neighborhood park
cards.notes: Bring class notes or a sketchbook, claim an open picnic table, and take a short outdoor break without arranging a reservation.
cards.short_summary: A small, simple outdoor table stop for a low-key break.
cards.evidence_claim: GVRD lists Fairmont Park’s children’s play area, picnic tables, and drinking fountain. Vallejo’s General Plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use an open table; bring supplies and pack out everything you bring.

cards.title: Trail-and-view walk at Mare Island Shoreline Heritage Preserve
cards.subtitle: Vallejo • Mare Island shoreline
cards.notes: Plan a daylight trail walk with a friend, pausing for habitat and shoreline views while staying on designated public routes.
cards.short_summary: A larger shoreline preserve for a purposeful outdoor walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Vallejo’s General Plan lists Mare Island Shoreline Heritage Preserve with walking, cycling, and equestrian trails plus habitat conservation and passive recreation. The plan says public parks provide free exercise and social opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Use designated public trails in daylight and check for any current site restrictions.
